name: Analog Systems I
description: The course covers the concepts of linearity and passivity in analog circuits, along with techniques for large-signal and small-signal analysis. It introduces the principles and applications of negative feedback and provides a foundation in MOSFET operation and characteristics. Students will study biasing circuits for stable transistor operation, the design and analysis of current mirrors, and the implementation of single-stage amplifiers.
